basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer • Windows Desktop • Distributed Systems • Enterprise Software
basic_info.about: C#/.NET software engineer with a track record of delivering high-performance desktop and cloud applications in regulated research and financial environments. Expert in Windows desktop development, microservices, SQL Server, CI/CD pipelines, and application security. Skilled at turning complex systems into stable, maintainable, and user-friendly software that drives results.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Windows desktop software developer working on a mature C#/.NET application (10+ years in production) deployed to laboratory workstations supporting preclinical research in oncology, diabetes, and PK/PD (pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics).

Specialized in application-layer development within a large legacy codebase, delivering bug fixes, refactoring, and new features while maintaining stability, performance, and backward compatibility.

Core focus areas included Windows desktop architecture, data synchronization, system integration, and performance optimization in regulated research environments.

Key contributions included:

- Redesigning and reimplementing the data synchronization architecture, significantly improving performance and reliability between laboratory workstations and on-prem server systems

- Implemented application-layer SQL Server integration for data access, synchronization, and offline/online workflows

- Building rich Windows UI components and data visualizations using DevExpress

- Implementing reporting and import/export features to Microsoft Word and Excel using document-generation libraries

- Integrated scientific computing and analytics tools, including R for equations and calculations and GraphPad Prism for statistical graphing

- Developing communication layers to interface with laboratory hardware via COM ports and named pipes, including balances, calipers, and scanners

- Managing CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to support automated builds and deployments

- Supporting application security initiatives through static analysis and vulnerability scanning with Veracode

experience.title: Technology Lead / Software Developer
experience.description:
Employed by Infosys, worked onsite at Charles Schwab on Streetsmart Edge trading platform as Tech Lead.

Contributed to enterprise-scale financial trading applications, delivering secure, high-performance solutions. Skilled in full-stack development, cloud integration, and CI/CD pipeline maintenance, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the StreetSmart Edge platform for active traders.

Key Contributions & Impact

- Developed and maintained desktop and cloud applications using C#, .NET, WPF, MVVM, and ASP.NET, contributing to critical trading functionality

- Worked on both frontend and backend systems, implementing new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements

- Contributed to the development of cloud-based microservices and APIs deployed on Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), integrated with enterprise platforms like Citrix

- Utilized SQL databases for development and testing of microservices, collaborating closely with the dedicated DB team

- Maintained existing CI/CD pipelines for desktop and cloud applications, ensuring smooth deployments and reliable releases

- Identified and remediated security vulnerabilities using Veracode, ensuring enterprise-level application security

- Collaborated with DevOps, QA, DB, and client teams, including offshore developers, to deliver high-quality software

- Operated in an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives

Technologies

C#, .NET, ASP.NET, WPF, MVVM, SQL Server, Microservices, REST APIs, Cloud Computing, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), CI/CD, DevOps, Veracode, Application Security, Citrix, Agile, Scrum, Enterprise Software, Financial Systems, Trading Platforms

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description:
Creator and lead developer of FFXIV TexTools, a widely used modding toolkit for Final Fantasy XIV, enabling the creation, editing, and installation of custom game assets (textures, models, animations). Reverse engineered proprietary game file formats to enable safe, client-side asset modification. Built with C# and .NET Framework, featuring a WPF-based desktop UI for an intuitive user experience. Developed a modular architecture separating core asset manipulation logic from the UI, supporting scalability, extensibility, and plugin-ready workflows. Maintained an open-source project on GitHub, collaborating with the community on enhancements and ensuring cross-functional usability.

Key Technologies: C# / .NET Framework, WPF, GitHub, NSIS installers, FBX handling, reverse engineering, modular architecture, open-source collaboration

Key Contributions & Impact:

- Reverse Engineered Game Assets: Analyzed and decoded FFXIV proprietary file formats to allow safe and reliable modification of textures, models, and animations.

- Built Scalable Modding Framework: Designed a modular architecture separating core logic from UI, enabling extensibility and plugin support.

- Developed Intuitive Desktop Tool: Created a WPF-based GUI for streamlined asset browsing, editing, and installation, improving usability for the modding community.

- Open Source Leadership: Maintained and grew the GitHub repository, fostering a collaborative environment for contributors and mod developers.

- Community Impact: Enabled hundreds of thousands of players to safely customize game assets, supporting creativity while keeping modifications client-side only.

projects.name: FFXIV TexTools
projects.description: A community-driven modding toolkit for Final Fantasy XIV that enables users to browse, export, edit, and re-import game assets such as textures and 3D models. Developed as an open-source framework, TexTools allows creators to build and share custom mods, empowering the FFXIV community with enhanced in-game customization.
